content.short: Stablecoin savings protocol, formerly Rings, earning yield on USD and ETH across several chains.
content.description: Trevee is the new name of Rings. Its Earn product is a savings vault for dollars and ETH: users stake scUSD or scETH on Sonic, or plUSD on Plasma, to earn yield from the strategies behind them. Following a governance vote, the old PAL token is migrating one to one into TREVEE, which can be staked in per-chain safety modules that protect Earn deposits and collect protocol revenue.
content.meta: Trevee, formerly Rings, runs stablecoin and ETH savings vaults on Sonic and Plasma, with TREVEE staking as backstop.
